_comment: Add the mcpServers block below to your claude_desktop_config.json.
_which_build: Get-AppxPackage *Claude*  -- if it returns a package you have the Store build, which is sandboxed and does NOT read %APPDATA%\Claude (verified 2026-08-17).
_2026_08_18_correction: This file used to offer two forms and NEITHER works with the documented venv install:
(a) "command": "civil3d-mcp"  -- the exe lives in .venv\Scripts\ which is not on PATH;
(b) "command": "python" + cwd/PYTHONPATH -- bare python is the system interpreter and has none of the dependencies.
Use the absolute path to .venv\Scripts\civil3d-mcp.exe. JSON does not expand environment variables, so edit YOURNAME per machine.
_save_without_bom: PowerShell 'Out-File -Encoding utf8' adds a BOM; Claude Desktop then fails to parse the JSON and the server SILENTLY never starts. Use Set-Content -Encoding utf8NoBOM.
_verify: Select-String 'Server started and connected successfully' "$env:APPDATA\Claude\logs\mcp*.log" | Select-Object -Last 3

_optional_civil3d_bin_path._comment: Only if Civil 3D is not in a default location. This env block is one of only two ways the server can receive it -- it does NOT read .env.
